name: tubigtala-devtools
description: Local-only tools: Firestore rules tests, emulator seed data, and a simulated device. Everything here targets the emulator under the demo-tubigtala project ID and cannot reach a real Firebase project.

scripts.test:rules: node firebase.mjs emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-tubigtala "node --test rules.test.mjs"
